endpoints.stats: GET https://stats-data.hyperliquid.xyz/Mainnet/vaults (all vaults, closed included; summary + coarse pnls)
endpoints.details: POST https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info {"type":"vaultDetails","vaultAddress":...} (portfolio histories, leaderFraction, leaderCommission, followers (top 100 only), allowDeposits, isClosed)

fetch_plan.rule: core: tvl >= 10000 or max |coarse allTime pnl| >= 1000 or HLP family; sample: 10% of the rest, seed 20261010

files.precommit.json: variant list and rules, hashed before forward returns were computed

api_gaps: no history of leaderFraction, follower count or allowDeposits: only today's values, so they cannot be signals and the deposit gate at t is assumed open while the vault was open
followers list is capped at 100 entries (largest first), so follower counts above 100 are unknown
allTime grid is 24 h / 168 h / 336 h by the vault's age today, so month-end values are the last grid point <= t and holding windows start at the first point >= t (<= 14 days later)
the profit share is charged on withdrawal by the protocol; the simulator charges it on the follower's cost basis, which is the documented rule, but the exact on-chain crystallisation was not observed
